minutes.headline: ZBA granted the Proctor lot 1 special permits and driveway variance, then a lot 2 gas station permit with conditions.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard two applications from Daniel Proctor for the electric Ave parcels: lot 1 (driveway, sign and storage relief) and lot 2 (gas station, convenience store and drive-through donut shop). Town board letters were read, an abutter raised noise, lighting and drainage concerns, and the board granted both with conditions, including a one-year review of hours and privacy fencing.

public_comment.topic: Abutter at 408 raised concerns about hours, lights and noise, screening, snow storage and storm drain flooding.

votes.motion: Grant the special permits for lot 1 (driveway width, driveway setback, outdoor storage, second sign).
Grant the variance for the lot 1 driveways for safety reasons.
Grant the lot 2 special permit with conditions: screening, privacy fence, 24-hour gas/convenience with one-year review, drive-through 5 to 11, sewer commission approval.

decisions.decision: Board members agreed to condition 24-hour gas and convenience store operation on a one-year review, with the drive-through limited to 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.
Applications handled as two decisions; lot 1 deliberated first, with the variance decided separately from the special permits.
Sewer Commission, conservation and other board approvals to be imposed as conditions.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for the lot 2 gas station, convenience store and drive-through donut shop, with conditions.
The board approved the lot 1 special permits for driveway width, driveway setback, outdoor storage and a second sign; the vote was not audible in the captions.
The board granted a separate variance for the lot 1 driveways, citing safety.
Members agreed to tie 24-hour gas and convenience store operation to a one-year review, with the drive-through limited to 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.
An abutter raised concerns about hours, lights, noise, screening, snow storage and storm drain flooding.

why_it_matters: The approval allows a new gas station with round-the-clock fuel and store hours on Electric Avenue, so nearby residents may see changes in noise, lighting, traffic and drainage, which the screening, fencing and one-year review conditions are meant to limit.
watch_next: The one-year review of 24-hour gas and convenience store hours, and the Sewer Commission approval and other board approvals imposed as conditions.
